entries.2cd5f5bb478bf950: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥963,213 million, up 4.4% year on year. In the Packaging Container Business, sales volume decreased, but the company implemented price revisions. Factors behind the increase in revenue include the recovery of the overseas engineering business, which had been sluggish in the previous fiscal year, and the consolidation of PREMIER CENTRE GROUP SDN. BHD., which operates a filling business for home care and personal care products in Malaysia. Revenue from external customers was ¥602,297 million in the Packaging Container Business, the largest; ¥179,344 million in the Engineering, Filling and Logistics Business; ¥91,463 million in the Steel Sheet-Related Business; ¥57,785 million in the Functional Materials-Related Business; ¥8,332 million in the Real Estate-Related Business; and ¥23,989 million in Other, which is not included in reportable segments.

entries.9a4d2c43dd997523: The company, together with 85 subsidiaries (74 consolidated and 11 non-consolidated) and 7 affiliates, forms a group of 'comprehensive container manufacturers'. The company is a holding company; it forms corporate groups by business, and each corporate group formulates domestic and overseas strategies and carries out its business. There are five reportable segments: the Packaging Container Business, the Engineering, Filling and Logistics Business, the Steel Sheet-Related Business, the Functional Materials-Related Business and the Real Estate-Related Business. The accounting standards are Japanese GAAP (Japan GAAP).

entries.a775da2975a09bbe: A business that manufactures and sells functional materials, including aluminum substrates for magnetic disks, optical functional films, glazes, pigments, gel coats and trace-element fertilizers. Mainly 10 consolidated subsidiaries, including Toyo Kohan Co., Ltd., TOMATEC Co., Ltd. and 8 others, are involved. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external sales were ¥57,785 million (up 11.4% year on year). Market conditions recovered for hard disk applications for data centers, and aluminum substrates for magnetic disks increased. Optical functional films declined due to the impact of deteriorating market conditions for flat panel displays.

entries.baefccbb45f9cad9: Based on its vision looking ahead to 2050, 'Long-Term Management Vision 2050 Wrapping the Future', and on its materiality, the company formulated its five-year 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2030', covering the five years from fiscal 2026, in May 2026. It sets business strategies for each of the mature and growth business domains and, to shift human resources from the mature to the growth domains, will work on enhancing and transforming human capital, improving operational efficiency through digital technology, and reforming its organizational culture. In addition, its policy is to invest management resources in growth fields such as the Engineering, Filling and Logistics Business, the Steel Sheet-Related Business and the Functional Materials-Related Business and, mainly in the domestic Packaging Container Business, to pursue appropriate price pass-through and the restructuring of unprofitable business areas and sites.
